mapper.select: select /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectPpsUsrInfo */ b.company_nm , b.company_url , a.user_nm , a.user_phone , a.user_email from seinfo_vendor_manager a join seinfo_vendor b on a.company_no = b.company_no where a.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and a.bl_yn = 'N'

select /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectUsrUid */ user_uid, bl_yn from seinfo_vendor_manager a where a.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and a.bl_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectPpsRegForm */ a.proposal_no , a.user_uid , a.proposal_title , a.proposal_area , a.proposal_area_cont , a.proposal_detail , a.mfile_group_id , DATE_FORMAT(a.send_d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS send_d , a.state_lrtp , a.state_rtp , (SELECT company_nm FROM seinfo_vendor WHERE company_no = b.company_no ) AS company_nm , (SELECT code_nm || IF(a.proposal_area ='99', ' : '||a.proposal_area_cont, '') AS code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id ='RTPC001' AND code_value = a.proposal_area ) AS proposal_area_nm , a.chief_manager FROM seinfo_proposal a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.user_uid = b.user_uid WHERE proposal_no = #{proposalNo} AND b.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(b.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' AND b.bl_yn = 'N';

select /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.getLastProposalNo */ proposal_no from seinfo_proposal WHERE proposal_no like concat('SYNC', date_format(now(), '%y%m'), '%') order by proposal_no desc limit 1
mapper.insert: INSERT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.insertProposal */ INTO seinfo_proposal ( proposal_no , user_uid , proposal_title , proposal_area , proposal_area_cont , proposal_detail , mfile_group_id , state_rtp , state_lrtp , send_d , reg_dt , reg_user_id , mod_dt , mod_user_id ) VALUES ( #{proposalNo} , #{userUid} , LEFT(#{proposalTitle}, 100) , #{proposalArea} , LEFT(#{proposalAreaCont}, 100) , #{proposalDetail} , #{fileGrpId} , #{stateLrtp} /* 상태코드 : 내부, 외부 동일 */ , #{stateLrtp} , #{sendD} , now() , #{userEmail} , now() , #{userEmail} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE proposal_title = LEFT(VALUES(proposal_title), 100) , proposal_area = VALUES(proposal_area) , proposal_area_cont = LEFT(VALUES(proposal_area_cont), 100) , proposal_detail = VALUES(proposal_detail) , state_rtp = VALUES(state_rtp) , state_lrtp = VALUES(state_lrtp) , mfile_group_id = VALUES(mfile_group_id) , send_d = VALUES(send_d) , mod_dt = VALUES(mod_dt) , mod_user_id = VALUES(mod_user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectPpsHistoryList */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY proposal_no ASC) AS rnum , proposal_no , CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(proposal_title) > 30 THEN LEFT(proposal_title, 30) || '...' ELSE proposal_title END AS proposal_title , IFNULL(comState.code_nm, '회원등록') AS step_vender /* 진행단계 */ , CASE WHEN send_d IS NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%y.%m.%d') WHEN send_d IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(send_d, '%y.%m.%d') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(send_d, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS send_d , IFNULL(comLast.code_nm, '') AS assess_result /* 심의결과 */ , last_result FROM seinfo_proposal INNER JOIN ( SELECT gr.proposal_no AS gr_no , CASE WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '35' THEN '35' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '40' THEN '40' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp = '30' THEN '30' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '20' AND gr.state_rtp != '30' THEN '20' WHEN gr.state_lrtp = '50' AND gr.add_no_cnt > 0 THEN '75' ELSE gr.state_lrtp END AS gr_state FROM ( SELECT lps.proposal_no, MAX(lps.state_lrtp) AS state_lrtp, MAX(lps.state_rtp) AS state_rtp, COUNT(lrc.request_seq) AS add_no_cnt FROM seinfo_proposal lps LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont lrc ON lrc.proposal_no = lps.proposal_no AND lrc.request_yn = 'A' AND lrc.answer_yn = 'R' AND lrc.approval_yn = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont aw WHERE aw.proposal_no = lrc.proposal_no AND aw.request_yn = lrc.request_yn AND aw.request_seq = lrc.request_seq AND aw.answer_yn = 'A' ) WHERE lps.user_uid = ( SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a WHERE a.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' ) GROUP BY lps.proposal_no ) gr ) lps ON lps.gr_no = proposal_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT code_id, code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC004' ) comLast ON comLast.code_value = ( CASE WHEN state_lrtp = '90' AND assess_skip_yn = 'Y' THEN 'R' ELSE last_result END ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT code_id, code_value, code_nm FROM zzz_code_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND code_parent_id = 'RTPC010' ) comState ON comState.code_value = lps.gr_state WHERE user_uid = ( SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a WHERE a.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' ) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{startRow}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.getPpsHistoryListCount */ COUNT(*) FROM seinfo_proposal WHERE user_uid = ( SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager a WHERE a.user_email = #{userEmail} AND IFNULL(a.user_pwd_init_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND a.bl_yn = 'N' )

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectPpsProcess */ a.proposal_no , CASE /* 상태별 표시 */ WHEN a.state_lrtp is null then '1' WHEN a.state_lrtp='01' or a.state_lrtp='10' then '2' WHEN a.state_lrtp='20' or a.state_lrtp='90' then '3' WHEN a.state_lrtp='50' or a.state_lrtp='80' then '4' WHEN a.state_lrtp='99' then '5' ELSE '1' END AS progress , DATE_FORMAT(b.reg_dt, '%Y.%m.%d') AS member_regist_d /* 회원등록 날짜 */ , CASE /* 기술제안 날짜 */ WHEN a.send_d IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.send_d, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '' END AS send_d , DATE_FORMAT(a.chief_manager_d, '%Y.%m.%d') AS chief_manager_d /* 접수 날짜 */ , CASE /* 평가제외 날짜 */ WHEN a.state_lrtp='90' AND a.assess_skip_yn='Y' THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.last_result_d, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '' END AS assess_skip_d , DATE_FORMAT(a.assess_appr_d, '%Y.%m.%d') AS assess_appr_d /* 검토완료 날짜 */ , CASE /* 결과안내 날짜 */ WHEN a.state_lrtp='99' AND a.last_result_yn='Y' THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.last_result_d, '%Y.%m.%d') ELSE '' END AS last_result_d , CASE /* 평가제외 여부 */ WHEN a.state_lrtp='90' AND a.assess_skip_yn='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS assess_skip_yn , a.assess_skip_res , last_result_yn , a.last_result , a.last_result_cont , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont c WHERE a.proposal_no = c.proposal_no AND c.request_yn='A' AND c.answer_yn='A' AND c.agree_yn='Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS add_request_yn FROM seinfo_proposal a JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager b ON a.user_uid = b.user_uid WHERE a.user_uid = (SELECT user_uid FROM seinfo_vendor_manager m WHERE m.user_email = #{userEmail} and IFNULL(m.user_pwd_init_yn,'N') != 'Y' and m.bl_yn = 'N' ) AND a.proposal_no = #{proposalNo}

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.selectPpsDetail */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.reg_dt ASC, a.request_seq ASC) AS rnum , a.request_seq , a.request_yn , a.answer_yn , a.draw_title , a.draw_contents , a.assessor_team /*비밀유지서약서 및 폐기확인서 조회시 필요 (upd 2025.04.06)*/ , DATE_FORMAT(a.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reg_dt , CASE WHEN a.request_due_d IS NOT NULL THEN DATE_FORMAT(a.request_due_d, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE '' END AS request_due_d , a.reg_user_id , a.proposal_no , CASE WHEN a.request_yn = 'M' AND b.answer_yn = 'A' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mod_request_yn /*수정요청 답변등록*/ , CASE WHEN a.request_yn = 'A' AND c.answer_yn = 'A' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS add_request_yn /*추가요청 답변등록*/ , CASE WHEN a.request_yn = 'A' AND c.agree_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' WHEN a.request_yn = 'A' AND c.proposal_no IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS read_report_yn /*비밀유지서약서*/ , a.reg_user_id , svm.user_nm AS assessorname FROM seinfo_request_cont a LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont b ON b.proposal_no = a.proposal_no AND b.request_yn = a.request_yn AND b.request_seq = a.request_seq AND b.answer_yn = 'A' AND b.request_yn = 'M' /*수정요청 답변등록*/ LEFT JOIN seinfo_request_cont c ON c.proposal_no = a.proposal_no AND c.request_yn = a.request_yn AND c.request_seq = a.request_seq AND c.answer_yn = 'A' AND c.request_yn = 'A' /* 추가요청 답변등록 */ LEFT JOIN seinfo_vendor_manager svm ON svm.user_email = a.reg_user_id WHERE a.proposal_no = #{proposalNo} AND ( (a.request_yn = 'M' AND a.answer_yn = 'R') /* 수정 요청 */ OR (a.request_yn = 'A' AND a.answer_yn = 'R' AND a.approval_yn = 'Y') /* 추가 요청 */ ) ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.PpsMapper.getModRequestYn */ main.request_seq AS request_seq ,CASE WHEN request_yn = 'M' AND answer_yn = 'R' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM seinfo_request_cont sub WHERE sub.proposal_no = main.proposal_no AND sub.request_seq = main.request_seq AND sub.request_yn = 'M' AND sub.answer_yn = 'A' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mod_request_yn FROM seinfo_request_cont main WHERE proposal_no = #{proposalNo} AND request_seq = #{requestSeq} AND request_yn = 'M' AND answer_yn = 'R'

SELECT /* com.seinfo.protoA.component.proposal.mapper.findRequestContBySeq */ assessor_team , draw_title , draw_contents FROM seinfo_request_cont WHERE proposal_no = #{proposalNo} AND request_seq = #{requestSeq} AND request_yn = 'M' AND answer_yn = 'R'
